context:
Goal: a gap in Anthropic's session tools that blocks our work gets fixed upstream.
Problem (cannot undo): a report to Anthropic leaves the org, so only you can send it.
Based on (read): the retrospective's ledger row D19 (Remote Control will not start a session on a turn another session started); nothing in this repo can fix it.
Based on (ruling): your 09:06 CST words on D20 (read receipts): build them in our own mailbox instead, so D20 left this item (step mail-read-receipt).
Departs from: main has no upstream report for this gap — adds one report.
Draft D19: "A Claude Code session on Remote Control refuses to start a new session when another session started the current turn. Expected: the start goes through, or the refusal names the rule."

options.gain: The gap reaches the team that can fix it.
options.how: In any Claude Code session, type /bug and paste draft D19.
options.label: Send D19 as drafted (recommended)
options.lose: About a minute of your time.

options.how: Nothing is sent; the step stays open.
options.label: Hold it

short: Report the Remote Control start refusal to Anthropic
title: May the Remote Control start refusal be reported to Anthropic as drafted?
why: A report to Anthropic leaves the org and cannot be taken back, so you send it.
